_about: CISA BOD 26-04 Appendix A, Table 1: Remediation Timelines. Each asset-vulnerability pair is looked up by its four values. Days are calendar days. Transcribed from the table image on the CISA directive page; do not edit rows without re-checking the source.
directive: BOD 26-04: Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk
clock_start: Whichever comes first: the date CISA added the CVE to KEV, or the date the vulnerability was first detected on the asset.
forensic_triage_note: '3 days & forensic triage' means remediate or mitigate within 3 days and triage the asset for signs of compromise.

variables.publicly_exposed: Yes if the asset is reachable by unauthenticated or untrusted entities over public networks such as the internet.
variables.in_kev: Yes if the CVE is in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
variables.automatable: SSVC 'Automatable' value from CISA Vulnrichment (yes / no).
variables.technical_impact: SSVC 'Technical Impact' value from CISA Vulnrichment (total / partial).

unknown_values._about: VulnHQ policy, not part of the directive (SRS FR-PRI-08, A2). When a value is unknown, evaluate every possible value, use the most urgent tier (lowest number), and flag the finding.
unknown_values.flag_text: Tier assumes the worst case for: {fields}. Confirm to get the exact deadline.
